一个教一个学，不知不觉就到了下班点儿了，王野这次没有等着王铁柱，背着包就往回走了。

走在路上，王铁柱载着赵爷爷就超过了王野，就这么看着王野在后面慢慢走着，连句话也没说。

王野心想：“这个爹不能要了，有时间必须回趟老家给这个爹上上眼药。”

郁闷了一路，王野一到家门口就看见围了一堆人，这是王野家又停了一辆吉普车。王野赶紧上前两步从人群中回到家。

一进家门，王野就看见一屋子的人，除了自己家人还有一个是王野认识的，那就是陈近岳。

王野看见自己的母亲双眼通红，应该是哭过，就赶紧上前站在秦婉身后，生怕有什么不好的事情找到自己家。

而且王野立刻换了自己的呼吸法，身上的气势一下子就释放出来了。整个屋子瞬间都安静了，陈近岳和另一个中年男人身后的警卫员，手都放在了腰间的枪上了。

王野见这两个人的举动，更加警惕了，单手伸进包里随时准备拿出手枪。王野有信心可以瞬间解决两人。中年男人看这架势立刻出声喝止：“没你们事，出去等着！”

两人没有犹豫敬了个礼就出门了。中年人说：“你就是小野吧，我是你舅舅。”

王野疑惑的看向秦婉吗，怎么就冒出来一个舅舅。

秦婉点点头表示认同，王野也收起了自己的气势。

中年人哈哈大笑：“哈哈哈，小野可以呀！气势逼人，不简单呀！”

王野笑了一下说：“不知道您可不可以给我详细解释一下，您和我母亲的关系？”

中年人微微点头，这是对王野的认可，要是一个普通人听说有这么一个大官是自己舅舅，那得高兴成什么样子。这以后肯定发达了。可是王野似乎并不是很在乎这个大官的舅舅。

中年人说：“我叫秦伟，是你母亲秦婉的亲大哥。你姥姥姥爷在你母亲刚出生那年就去世了，被地主迫害死的。我在家乡的私塾先生的帮助下，带着你母亲到了四岁。”

“老家有人组织了起义，我为了给父母报仇也参加了。在参加之前，我把你母亲托付给了私塾先生。谁知天意弄人，我这一参军就是两年。回到家乡私塾一家已经不见了，经过我多方打探，才知道先生为了躲避战乱北上了。你母亲也就被带走了。”

“我这么多年一边打仗一边寻找，从南到北我几乎找遍了半个国家。皇天不负有心人啊，终于让我找到了！”

王野可没有放下疑心，继续问：“我相信以你的身份和地位肯定证实过了，但是我想听听你的证实过程。”

秦伟心想：“我擦！这孩子这么谨慎吗？我再怎么说也是一名中将呀！有我这么一个舅舅很丢人吗？”

没办法呀，这是自己亲外甥，继续说吧：“当年我爹留下了一块儿牌子，这是咱家祖传的，也是当时家里唯一一件值点钱的东西。我怕我一去不回，就把牌子留给了你母亲。”

秦婉也把牌子拿了出来，王野拿起牌子细细端详，这块牌子王野的原身见过，在很小的时候从一个小盒子翻出来的，因为这个还被秦婉揍了一顿。

秦伟继续说：“我也派人去你们村打听过了，打听的人就是你爷爷，你母亲的养父就是当年的私塾先生。”

说完从兜里取出一张照片，继续说：“就算你还不信，给你看看这个，这是我年轻时的照片。”

王野接过照片一看，心里想：“我擦！跟自己也太像了！都说外甥像舅，这也太像了！两人得有八九分相像。”

秦伟看着王野的样子哈哈大笑道：“哈哈哈，怎么样，现在信了吧？就你这样子说不是我外甥都没人信。现在可以叫我一声舅舅了吧？”

One taught and the other learned, and before you knew it, it was time to get off work. Wang Ye did not wait for Wang Tiezhu this time, and walked back with his bag on his back.

While walking on the road, Wang Tiezhu took Grandpa Zhao and passed Wang Ye. He just watched Wang Ye walking slowly behind without saying a word.

Wang Ye thought: "I can't have this father anymore. I have to go back to my hometown when I have time to put eye drops on this father."

After being depressed all the way, Wang Ye saw a crowd of people gathered around him as soon as he arrived at the door of his house. This was another jeep parked at Wang Ye's house.Wang Ye quickly took two steps forward and returned home from the crowd.

As soon as he entered the house, Wang Ye saw a room full of people. In addition to his own family, there was another person Wang Ye knew, and that was Chen Jinyue.

Wang Ye saw that his mother's eyes were red, she must have been crying, so he quickly stepped forward and stood behind Qin Wan, fearing that something bad would come to his home.

Moreover, Wang Ye immediately changed his breathing method, and the aura on his body was immediately released.The whole room fell silent instantly. The security guard behind Chen Jinyue and another middle-aged man put their hands on the guns at their waists.

Seeing the actions of these two men, Wang Ye became even more vigilant. He reached into his bag with one hand and was ready to take out a pistol at any time.Wang Ye was confident that he could deal with the two of them instantly.The middle-aged man saw this posture and immediately shouted: "It's none of your business, go out and wait!"

The two of them saluted without hesitation and went out.The middle-aged man said: "You must be Xiaoye, I am your uncle."

Wang Ye looked at Qin Wan in confusion. Why did an uncle appear?

Qin Wan nodded in agreement, and Wang Ye also calmed down his momentum.

The middle-aged man laughed loudly: "Hahaha, Xiaoye can do it! The momentum is so overwhelming, it's not easy!"

Wang Ye smiled and said, "I wonder if you could explain to me in detail the relationship between you and my mother?"

The middle-aged man nodded slightly, which was recognition of Wang Ye. If an ordinary person heard that such a high official was his uncle, how happy he would be.It will definitely become more developed in the future.But Wang Ye didn't seem to care much about this high-ranking official's uncle.

The middle-aged man said: "My name is Qin Wei, and I am the eldest brother of your mother Qin Wan. Your great-grandfather passed away the year your mother was born and was persecuted to death by the landlords. With the help of my private school teacher in my hometown, I took your mother until she was four years old."

"Someone in my hometown organized an uprising, and I joined in order to avenge my parents. Before joining, I entrusted your mother to the private school teacher. Unexpectedly, God's will, I joined the army for two years. When I returned to my hometown, the private school family had disappeared. After I made many inquiries, I found out that the husband went north to escape the war. Your mother was also taken away."

"I have been searching while fighting for so many years. I have searched almost half of the country from south to north. God has paid off, and I finally found it!"

Wang Ye did not let go of his doubts and continued to ask: "I believe it has been confirmed based on your identity and status, but I want to hear your confirmation process."

Qin Wei thought to himself: "Oh no! Is this kid so cautious? I am a lieutenant general after all! Is it embarrassing to have an uncle like me?"

There's nothing I can do about it, this is my own nephew, so let's continue: "Back then, my father left a brand. It was passed down from our ancestors, and it was the only valuable thing in the family at that time. I was afraid that I would leave the brand to your mother if I never came back."

Qin Wan also took out the sign, and Wang Ye picked up the sign and looked at it carefully. Wang Ye had seen this sign before and dug it out of a small box when he was very young. Qin Wan even beat him up because of it.

Qin Wei continued: "I also sent people to your village to inquire. The person who inquired was your grandfather, and your mother's adoptive father was the private school teacher back then."

After speaking, he took out a photo from his pocket and continued: "Even if you still don't believe it, let me show you this. This is a photo of me when I was young."

Wang Ye took the photo and looked at it, and thought to himself: "Oh no! He looks so much like me! They say my nephew looks like my uncle, but this is so similar! The two of them must be eighty-nine percent alike."

Qin Wei looked at Wang Ye and laughed loudly: "Hahaha, how about it, do you believe it now? No one will believe it if you are not my nephew. Can you call me uncle now?"
